cards.text: Paul, called to be an apostle (Romans 1:1), writes to the church of the Thessalonians, in Thessalonica, a city in Macedonia (Acts 27:2). Silvanus and Timothy, who preached Christ with him (2 Corinthians 1:19), put their names on it too, like a card from the whole office, except NOBODY had to chase these guys down for a signature. Paul opens by wishing them grace and peace.

cards.question: Paul tells the Thessalonians that he and his team thank God for them only now and then.

cards.text: When they pray, Paul and his team keep recalling before God the Thessalonians' work of faith, their labor of love and their enduring hope. If anybody ever remembers ME like that, I hope they skip the batch I stamped upside down.

cards.question: Paul remembers the Thessalonians' enduring hope. Who is that hope in?

cards.text: Paul calls them brothers who are beloved by God and says he knows God has chosen them. How? Because the gospel came to them not only in word, but also with great conviction.

cards.question: Paul says the gospel came to the Thessalonians in word and with great conviction. What else does he say it came in?

cards.text: The Thessalonians know how Paul's team lived among them, for their sake. And they welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, and friend, that's not fresh-out-of-the-oven joy, that's a WHOLE other level.

cards.question: The Thessalonians welcomed the message with joy, in spite of their great ___.
When the Thessalonians welcomed the message, they became imitators of whom?
As a result, Paul says the Thessalonians became an ___ to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

cards.text: The message of the Lord rang out from the Thessalonians to Macedonia and Achaia. That's Ruby, one of my cookie cutter kids, all over: she's a little bell, and when she rings, the WHOLE kitchen stops to listen.

cards.question: Paul says news of the Thessalonians' faith in God stayed inside Macedonia and Achaia.
With the Thessalonians' faith known everywhere, what does Paul say his team has no need to do?

cards.text: Picture Paul starting to brag on them and everybody going, "Yeah, we HEARD." People report it themselves, including what kind of welcome the Thessalonians gave Paul's team.

cards.question: Those reports say the Thessalonians turned to God from ___.

cards.text: They turned to serve the living and true God, and they're waiting too. I know waiting, friend, I did YEARS in a junk drawer, but nobody in there was waiting on anything this good.

cards.question: The Thessalonians are waiting for someone to come from heaven. Who is it?
Paul says the Son the Thessalonians are waiting for is the One God raised from the dead.

cards.text: And Paul says who He is: "Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath." Now THAT'S the One worth waiting on, friend.
